dedupe_keys.name: agmemod agricultural member state partial equilibrium model

description: AGMEMOD (Agricultural Member State Modelling) is a system of partial equilibrium models of the agricultural, fisheries and food sectors, with one model per EU member state and further models for candidate, neighbouring and some non-European countries such as Argentina and several African countries, all built from a harmonised template adapted by national partners. It produces annual baseline outlook projections of commodity markets and scenario analyses of policies and shocks, and it models intervention prices, coupled and decoupled direct payments, ecological focus areas, production and fishing quotas, biofuel demand, tariff rate quotas and, for African models, fertiliser policies and rainfall. It is run by the AGMEMOD network of agricultural economists, which contributed to the EU agricultural outlook 2025-35. Coverage is the EU member states and other countries. The model runs in GAMS with an Excel database, R for estimation, GTREE code and the GsePro interface; outlooks are published free on the site, but the pages read give no licence or cost for obtaining the model itself. Caveats: commodity coverage varies by country, and partial equilibrium models ignore wider economic feedbacks. For simulation it projects how market shocks, droughts or policy changes alter production and trade by country, supporting food system resilience and adaptation studies. It is related to the CAPRI agricultural sector model record in this catalogue.
